title: Customer service
intro: We will let your own AI agent call a company for you and fix a billing mistake.

steps.say: This chat is made up, and nothing is sent. You have a billing mistake with your internet company.
act: You have a billing mistake with your internet company. Today you would call and wait on their AI agent.

steps.say: Your own agent will call instead.
act: Instead, I will call them for you. I already have your account details from your dashboard, so their agent cannot block me with questions.
Billing question ready|a $30 charge you did not expect

steps.say: You press to make the call.
act: Done. They agreed the charge was a mistake and credited you $30.

steps.say: Your agent needs enough of your information to act for you.
act: Demo only. Your agent needs enough of your information to act for you. The dashboard gives it that.
